result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<html lang="ar" dir="rtl"><head><title>RTL Document</title></head><body><p>This is right-to-left text.</p></body></html>', HtmlToMarkdownRs::ConversionOptions.new(extract_metadata: true))
